crossRefs.note: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man, and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then…
But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will…

translations.web: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.
translations.bsb: When a strong man, fully armed, guards his house, his possessions are secure.
translations.kjv: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
translations.asv: When the strong man fully armed guardeth his own court, his goods are in peace:
